name: Grave Shift
storyline: After a night shift disappears in the mines beneath Marrow Run, fissures tear through the mining town and the dead rise. Summoned from an old cemetery tomb, the mysterious Keeper ventures out each night, returning to a hilltop refuge whether he survives or falls. With help from three survivors, he confronts the creatures ruling the cemetery and town while uncovering the truth behind the missing miners and the outbreak known as the Nightbloom.
summary: Grave Shift is a single-player survival horror roguelite. Players explore procedurally generated cemetery and town areas, manage ammunition and healing supplies, solve environmental puzzles, and fight undead enemies and bosses. Between runs, players return to a persistent hub to purchase upgrades and advance character stories.
